name: bubbles-355f960a-blind17-ots
instr:
# charmbracelet/bubbles: tracking down seventeen behaviour regressions without a test suite

The repository has received 17 separate undocumented edits, and what follows is everything we have managed to observe from the outside. An application built on this library assembles its interface out of small interactive pieces — scrolling panes of content, editable multi-line fields, filterable collections of items, pagers, gradient bars, grids of rows and columns — and those pieces now report the wrong state, move the wrong way and draw the wrong thing. Nothing about the terminal changed and nothing in our own code changed.

Start with what these pieces say about themselves. A shortcut built from some trigger presses and a description reports itself as available, which is right, but after we ask for it to be switched off it still reports itself as available, and it still does so once its trigger presses have been cleared away entirely. A freshly made pager claims two items fit on a screenful rather than one, so telling it there are five items leaves it with three screenfuls instead of five, and its count of items on the current screenful is doubled. Asking such a pager whether we sit on the very first screenful is answered one step late: on the first it says no, and one further along it says yes.
